hysplit.README.txt:
HYSPLIT cross-check for this scenario
Meteorology for past dates: download gdas1.nov26.w4 from https://www.ready.noaa.gov/data/archives/gdas1/ into this folder (or a finer ARL archive such as gfs0p25, nam12 or hrrr, and edit CONTROL's met lines). Archive files exist only after the fact; for a forecast, use NOAA ARL forecast meteorology (https://www.ready.noaa.gov/data/forecast/) and set CONTROL's met lines to it.
Run: hycs_std   (reads CONTROL and SETUP.CFG here, writes cdump)
Output: concentration in kg/m3 averaged over 0-100 m, hourly; deposition in kg/m2.
Online alternative: NOAA READY HYSPLIT (ready.noaa.gov) with the same start, location, heights and particle sizes.
